entries.en: The biochip – you can take a peek.
The biochip – I'll let you have a peek. If you can help me, that is.
entries.ro: Biochipul – îți dau voie să arunci o privire. Dacă mă ajuți, sigur.

entries.en: I am glad you have had change of heart.
Didn't exactly have much of a choice.
I know you've abandoned the hotel. Saw what NetWatch did there.
entries.ro: Știu că ai părăsit hotelul. Am văzut ce a făcut NetWatch acolo.

entries.en: You come to our chapel in Pacifica and must wait by de altar.
entries.ro: Vii la capela noastră din Pacifica și trebuie să aștepți lângă altar.
